Hi Matt / Nuvem team — following up with a more detailed commercial breakdown and options. Apologies for the quick spreadsheet churn; I attached Pricing_SKU_sheet_v2.xlsx with itemized SKUs and term-level discounts.

Short answers first:
- Platform fee amortization examples (monthly equivalent):
  • 12-mo term: platform fee paid monthly = full list monthly fee (no amortization)
  • 24-mo term: spread 12 months of platform fee discount across 24 months => effective ~10% reduction in year 1 spend
  • 36-mo term: spread 18 months of platform fee discount across 36 months => effective ~18% reduction in year 1 spend
- Support tiers (annual list):
  • Bronze: business hours, email support, next-business-day response.
  • Silver: extended hours (6am–10pm PT), 4h RTO for Sev1, 24/7 pager for on-call escalation (no named POC).
  • Gold: 24/7 with named escalation, 2h RTO, quarterly on-site review included.
- Migration credits: we can offer a one-time migration credit of $20,000 on an 18+ month committed contract.

We have captured your audit retention ask — 90 days is included; 180 days is an add-on SKU (SOC2_evidence.zip attached for what we typically provide). Pricing_SKU_sheet_v2 has line items for increased retention.

Deal ID: RWD-NUV-134 (use this in procurement docs).

If you prefer, we can structure platform fee as a recurring subscription (monthly) or roll it into the committed license and invoice annually. Rolling into an annual invoice locks price for the term and simplifies procurement.
